items.title: Nexa Lighthouse — Climate & Health Innovation Call (Asia-Pacific)
items.sectors: HealthTech, Climate, Public Health, MedTech, Social Impact
items.shortDesc: Nexa Lighthouse funds proven, locally led innovations in Asia and the Pacific that help health systems act on climate risks such as extreme heat, air pollution and shifting malaria/dengue patterns. A linked South Asia call focuses on protecting people with diabetes and heart disease from extreme heat.
items.provider: Grand Challenges Canada and AVPN, funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation
items.about: Nexa Lighthouse funds proven, locally led innovations in Asia and the Pacific that help health systems act on climate risks such as extreme heat, air pollution and shifting malaria/dengue patterns. A linked South Asia call focuses on protecting people with diabetes and heart disease from extreme heat. Proposals are due 17 November 2026 at 2:00 pm ET (12:30 am IST on 18 November) via Grand Challenges Canada's Fluxx portal — apply through that portal, not the Novo Nordisk Foundation, or you risk disqualification. Funding instrument (grant vs. repayable/equity-linked) is set at the partners' discretion. The South Asia cardiometabolic-heat strand must be framed around heat protection for patients, not general climate adaptation.
items.eligibility:
Incorporated organisations based in Asia-Pacific (India included): companies, social enterprises, NGOs, non-profits, research institutions or government bodies
Individuals, sole proprietorships, unincorporated trusts and partnerships cannot apply
Innovation must already be proven and ready to scale — this is not early-idea money
Solution must be locally led and address a climate-linked health threat (heat, air quality, vector-borne disease)
items.benefits:
Transition to Scale investment of roughly $250,000 to $2 million per innovation, sized by maturity
Backing from Grand Challenges Canada and AVPN's network of Asian funders
Support to embed the solution with local health actors and systems
